tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Quotients are orbifolds] 1. 13.2.1\group foundations Source: thurston:page-0320

If a group $\Gamma $ acts properly discontinuously on a manifold $M$, then $M/\Gamma $ has a natural orbifold structure. At the image of $\widetilde x$, the chart group is the isotropy group of $\widetilde x$.
Proof

\sketch Choose a small isotropy-invariant neighborhood of each lift, disjoint from its translates outside the isotropy group. Finite intersections lift to intersections of conjugate neighborhoods, with chart group the intersection of the corresponding conjugate isotropy groups.

□
